question: What are the most important parameters for improving PCE in n-i-p perovskite solar cells according to the ML model?
final_answer:
According to the global SHAP feature importance analysis for n-i-p perovskite solar cells, the most important parameters/features for improving PCE include:
1. ETL deposition method (importance: 0.376)
2. Perovskite quenching/crystallisation (importance: 0.3748)
3. Perovskite deposition synthesis atmosphere (importance: 0.3608)
4. Perovskite material (importance: 0.3542)
5. HTL additives/compounds (importance: 0.3428)
6. HTL deposition method (importance: 0.3135)
7. Presence of LiF (importance: 0.265)
8. Presence of ZnO (importance: 0.2377)
9. HTL HOMO level (importance: 0.1921)
10. Presence of SnO2 (importance: 0.1633)
